title: Rusty Sander
body:
" Used for turning logs into a milled form, the automated handsaw! " - Item description

Description

The Rusty Sander is the first obtainable tier of sanders in-game. It turns normal wood into sanded wood by removing its bark. Compared to the higher tiers of sanders in the game, it can only sand small pieces of wood.

Appearance

As the name may suggest, the rusty sander appears to be rusty and damaged, with a tan sanding pad and six individual sprinklers Blasting Sand.
